note: State groups are computational proxies for aggregating state-level HDS data, not dialect boundaries.

midwest.linguistic_status: broad convenience alias; crosses multiple dialect zones

upper-midwest.linguistic_status: state-level proxy overlapping North-Central / Upper Midwestern English; Wisconsin/Iowa are internally mixed

north-central.linguistic_status: conservative anchor-state proxy for North-Central evidence

great-lakes.linguistic_status: broad state-level proxy overlapping Inland North / Great Lakes speech; each state contains internal variation

inland-north.linguistic_status: state-level proxy only; ANAE dialect boundaries are sub-state

midland.linguistic_status: conservative state-level proxy for central/western Midland tendencies; Indiana/Ohio are internally mixed
